protocol.H23: Compare financing disclosures, plus dated cash pressure, plus reconciled saleable supply, plus both. Extracted financing contexts remain unverified; no future financing or eventual failure selects entry.
protocol.H24: Compare first provider-defined deficiency episodes, equity/market-value deficiencies, and those plus cash pressure. Repeated notices remain in the source denominator, never independent overlapping positions.
protocol.H25: Compare fixed targets with shrunk prior-other-issuer gross forecasts and size-dependent costs. Forecast labels must finish before the event clock with a 20-session embargo. At least 30 prior other issuers; no fallback future return.
protocol.H26: Retain unsupported patient covers as short liabilities; replay future daily cover opportunities with volume limits, carry, margin and explicit stale marks. Compare time exits, a 20% stop/target comparator and progressive covers.
protocol.entry: First cached exchange session opening after known_at plus five minutes. No private notice-date entry or pre-publication gap profit. Daily OHLC4 reference and capacity are conditional execution proxies, not broker fills.
protocol.liquidity: Entry budget uses prior 20-session volume; actual entry/cover quantity also capped at 5% of that session recorded volume. Restricted/unknown SSR entry uses case capture. Incomplete venue coverage is not multiplied by guessed off-exchange flow.
protocol.exit: Time exit after 2/5/10/20 sessions including entry. Residual cover shares remain open across later sessions, accrue obligations and remain in marked NAV until actually modeled covered. No zero-price terminal cover.
protocol.costs: Three joint execution+borrow cases. Size-dependent static-book-anchored cost sensitivity, per-share child commissions, dated regulatory fee schedule, ACT/360 rounded collateral, marginal tiered short credit; measured rates override assumptions only with timely evidence.
protocol.risk: One open position per issuer. +200% price-shock loss reserve capped at 2% of initial hypothetical NAV; 20% NAV margin headroom reserve; 100% house margin sensitivity plus low-price floors. This does not change live account rules.
protocol.statistics: Complete calendar marked equity including unresolved liabilities. Monthly and daily net dollars, CAGR on declared $10m, drawdown, Calmar, Sharpe, Sortino, expected shortfall, worst issuer/day, fees, carry, credit, cover completion and collateral/margin.
protocol.monte_carlo: Seeded three-month calendar-block bootstrap of daily portfolio cash/mark paths, retaining within-block issuer/overlap/cost dependence. Five years, 1000 trials. Parameter/recall/illiquidity stress is reported separately. No future-tail probability claim.
protocol.validation: Previously inspected and provider-prepared histories are exploratory development. Chronological and issuer-separated diagnostics; no untouched backtest claim. Designated execution holdout remains unread. Forward registry freezes estimates before entry and imports outcomes separately.

study_aggregates.method: Provider raw stock returns, pre-split-close or provider filing window; not short P&L. Changing horizon denominators and terminal-price treatment retained.

patient_liability_replay.method: Frozen one-hour/5%-flow entries and supported intraday covers retained. Unsupported buybacks, their fees and impact are undone. Residuals are marked as open shorts and subsequent daily covers use 5% recorded-volume capacity and cost sensitivities. Borrow/credit accrue on settled calendar days. Missing and fractional liabilities remain open. This obligation audit does not reapply entry admission or shared risk limits and is not observed execution.

cost_evidence.basis: Conditional static-book median at $25k; square-root size interpolation and transfer to new event dates are assumptions. Not measured patient $25k-$50k fills.
cost_evidence.borrow_basis: 20/50/150% APR sensitivities. Not a verified historical loan series.
cost_evidence.proceeds_interest_basis: Current IBKR Pro tiers frozen as a sensitivity; existing USD shorts consume the first $100k band. Calendar-day settled collateral; no repeated zero band.
cost_evidence.other_fee_allowance: $0.000003/share both sides is a fixed venue/CAT allowance, not a historical CAT-rate reconstruction.
